name: Last.fm

http.reason: Last.fm 艺术家/专辑 getInfo 与 search 接口，以及 track.scrobble / track.updateNowPlaying / auth.getToken / auth.getSession 播放记录上报与网页授权

description: Enriches artists and albums from Last.fm: biographies, images and external IDs via artist.getInfo / album.getInfo, falling back to name search when no MBID is known; also reports scrobbles and now-playing notifications via track.scrobble / track.updateNowPlaying. An admin configures the API key and shared secret; each user connects their Last.fm account in the browser (auth.getToken / auth.getSession) without sharing a password with TMA.
author: TMA

en.description: Enriches artists and albums from Last.fm: biographies, images and external IDs via artist.getInfo / album.getInfo, falling back to name search when no MBID is known; also reports scrobbles and now-playing notifications via track.scrobble / track.updateNowPlaying. An admin configures the API key and shared secret; each user connects their Last.fm account in the browser (auth.getToken / auth.getSession) without sharing a password with TMA.
en.config.api_key.title: API key
en.config.api_key.description: API key from last.fm/api/account/create. Used for scraping and for each user's Last.fm link.
en.config.shared_secret.title: Shared secret
en.config.shared_secret.description: Shared secret paired with the API key. Required for scrobbling and the Connect flow. Stored encrypted.
en.config.language.title: Bio language
en.config.language.description: Preferred language for biographies (zh/en/ja/de/fr); empty is treated as zh, retrying in English when empty.
en.user_config.session_key.title: Session key
en.user_config.session_key.description: Obtained when you click Connect and allow access on Last.fm; not a user-facing field.

zh.description: 用 Last.fm 补齐艺术家与专辑：经 artist.getInfo / album.getInfo 取简介、图片与外部 ID，未知 MBID 时先按名称搜索；并经 track.scrobble / track.updateNowPlaying 上报播放记录与正在播放。管理员配置 API key 与 Shared secret；每位用户在浏览器里连接自己的 Last.fm 账户（auth.getToken / auth.getSession），不必把密码交给 TMA。
zh.config.api_key.title: API key
zh.config.api_key.description: 在 last.fm/api/account/create 创建。刮削与用户连接共用。
zh.config.shared_secret.title: Shared secret
zh.config.shared_secret.description: 与 API key 配对的共享密钥。上报与「连接」流程需要。加密存储。
zh.config.language.title: 简介语言
zh.config.language.description: 简介首选语言（zh/en/ja/de/fr），留空按 zh 处理，取不到时回退英文。
zh.user_config.session_key.title: Session key
zh.user_config.session_key.description: 点击连接并在 Last.fm 允许访问后由系统写入，不是用户填写项。
zh.actions.test_connection.label: 测试连接
zh.actions.authorize.label: 连接
